$comment: Project-level Claude Code settings. Committed, so the whole team gets the same defaults.
$comment_cache: Workflow agents get a 5-minute cache TTL by default, separate from the main session. On wide fan-outs that means re-paying for the same prefix repeatedly. 1h costs more per write and is worth it above roughly a dozen agents.
$comment_ultracode: Deliberately NOT setting "ultracode": true. That would run every substantive task in every session as a multi-agent workflow. Opt in per task with the `ultracode` keyword, or per session with /effort ultracode.
